question: Wer war in der BBL-Saison 2025–2026 der beste Rebounder jedes Teams, gemessen an Rebounds pro Spiel (mindestens 15 Spiele)?

  SELECT player_team, player_name, trb, gp, trb::numeric / gp AS reb_per_game

ranked AS (
  SELECT player_team, player_name, trb, gp, reb_per_game,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_team ORDER BY reb_per_game DESC) as rn

FROM ranked

question: Zeig mir die 5 Teams mit dem besten Offensivrating in der EuroLeague-Saison 2023/24.
sql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    CASE UPPER(team)
      WHEN 'CRVENA ZVEZDA MERIDIAN BELGRADE' THEN 'Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade'
      WHEN 'PANATHINAIKOS ATHENS' THEN 'Panathinaikos Aktor Athens'
      WHEN 'BASKONIA VITORIA-GASTEIZ' THEN 'Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz'
      ELSE team
    END AS team,
    pts_per_poss_eigenes,
    anz_ballbstz_eigenes
  FROM gold.g_el_teams
  WHERE saison = '2023-2024'
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    SUM(pts_per_poss_eigenes * anz_ballbstz_eigenes) / SUM(anz_ballbstz_eigenes) AS offensive_rating
  FROM normalized
  GROUP BY team
)
SELECT team, offensive_rating
FROM merged
ORDER BY offensive_rating DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Aus welchen Ländern kamen die meisten Punkte in der letzten Euroleague Saison?
sql:
WITH season_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(regexp_replace(player_name, ', ', ' ')) AS norm_name
  FROM bronze.b_el_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15'
),
player_nat AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(regexp_replace(player_name, ', ', ' ')) AS norm_name,
    MAX(nationality) AS nationality
  FROM bronze.b_el_player_info
  GROUP BY UPPER(regexp_replace(player_name, ', ', ' '))
)
SELECT
  pn.nationality,
  SUM(b.pts) AS total_pts
FROM bronze.b_el_boxscore b
JOIN season_players sp
  ON UPPER(regexp_replace(b.player_name, ', ', ' ')) = sp.norm_name
JOIN player_nat pn
  ON sp.norm_name = pn.norm_name
WHERE b.date >= '2025-07-15' AND b.date < '2026-07-15'
GROUP BY pn.nationality
ORDER BY total_pts DESC
LIMIT 10

question: Gib mir eine Liste der 5 griechischen Spieler, die in der letzten Saison der Championsleague die meisten Drei-Punkte Würfe getroffen haben
sql:
WITH info AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (btrim(player_name))
         btrim(player_name) AS player_name, nationality
  FROM bronze.b_cl_player_info
  WHERE nationality ILIKE '%GRC%'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT btrim(player_name) AS player_name, SUM(three_p) AS three_p_made
  FROM bronze.b_cl_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15'

FROM stats s
JOIN info i ON s.player_name = i.player_name
ORDER BY s.three_p_made DESC
